mission.m1.name: Awakening
mission.m1.brief: You leave the shelter. Learn to move and shoot before they spot you.
mission.m2.name: Scrapyard
mission.m2.brief: Ambush at the Port Ash junkyard. Survive for 90 seconds.
mission.m3.name: Broken Bridge
mission.m3.brief: Escort the refugee convoy across Aureate Bridge. Don't let it be destroyed.
mission.m4.name: Campus Zero
mission.m4.brief: Sneak into the old Nimbora campus and hack 3 terminals. Watch out for turrets.
mission.m5.name: Night of the Hunters
mission.m5.brief: Something is stalking you in the ruins of Silica Valley. Destroy the Alpha Hunter.
mission.m6.name: The Core
mission.m6.brief: TUTELA, the AI that decided to protect us from ourselves, is here. Shut it down.
